request.style: English, pop, female vocal solo with ethereal choir, piano, soft synth pads, cello, gentle drums, uplifting and reverent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A sabbath rest remains for us
Whoever enters stops their works
Like God rested from His own
Make every effort to go on
So none fall by disobedience
Let us hold fast to the promise

[Chorus]
The word of God is living and active
Sharper than any two-edged sword
It pierces to the point where soul and spirit divide
Judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart

[Verse]
No creature is hidden from Him
Everything lies naked and exposed
Before the eyes of the one
To whom we must give account
We have a great high priest
Jesus the Son of God
Who has passed through the heavens
Let us hold fast to our confession

[Chorus]
The word of God is living and active
Sharper than any two-edged sword
It pierces to the point where soul and spirit divide
Judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart

[Bridge]
He sympathizes with our weaknesses
Tempted in every way as we are
Yet without sin, He stands near
A great high priest for our fear

[Chorus]
The word of God is living and active
Sharper than any two-edged sword
It pierces to the point where soul and spirit divide
Judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart

[Outro]
Living and active
Sharper than a sword
